service.description: Home's counts over the user's maintenance scope (a work read; with the assigned view alone, the user's own work), narrowed to an organization or a facility (with those inside it): open, unassigned, high priority and overdue work orders, read in a few queries; for a reader of work (MAINTENANCE_VIEW) the active plans overdue and the meter plans whose due is unknown (P14; at most 200 plans read, pmCapped), null for anyone else (never zero); the unavailable resources (P5). myWorkList: the user's open work, by priority and due; teamWorkList, for a broad reader only (teamTotals): per team its open, active, unscheduled, blocked and overdue work. No cost.

Preventive compliance over obligations, not work orders (design §8 PreventiveComplianceReport; MAINTENANCE_VIEW in the scope's organizations): the obligations due from fromDate through thruDate (the 90 days to the as-of time unless given) of the active and ended plans of the scope, an organization, a plan, a piece of equipment or a facility (with those inside it), at most 500 plans (capped). Each obligation is on time (satisfied by its due date), late, outstanding (passed, not done; a coalesced one until its catch-up is done), skipped, unknown (a plan with no time zone, a meter completion that took no reading, a meter plan whose reading is stale) or upcoming (due after the as-of time). The summary's denominator is the obligations due (on time, late, outstanding and skipped) and its on-time percentage the on time ones over it; unknown and upcoming ones are named as left out. A meter obligation is the threshold found reached, on time when its completion's reading is within it; no crossing date is invented. No cost.

parameter.name: outcome
parameter.description: onTime, late, outstanding, skipped, unknown or upcoming: the rows of one outcome (the summary counts all)

parameter.name: pageNoLimit
parameter.description: Every row, to 5000 (a CSV export, P17)

service.description: The cost of maintenance work (design §3 WorkCosts, §8 MaintenanceCostReport; impl-maintenance P11), for the cost reader only (MAINTENANCE_COST_VIEW with a work read; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise, so no other caller is answered an amount): one work order (workEffortId; a step reads as its work order, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope) with its estimate, or the work orders of the scope and the filters (any status; at most 2000, capped says so), the sources dated in the period (fromDate inclusive, thruDate exclusive). Each source once: a part issued at its asset's cost and each return naming it, less; each finished time entry, approved hours at the costing rate get#CostingRate answers for its class and work type (never a person's pay rate), unapproved and unpriced hours apart; each outside-service line from its bill, else its acceptance, once, what is ordered and not yet accepted pending. Totals by currency, never added across currencies; priced amounts by project. costs: asOf, workOrderCount, capped, totalList (per currency: parts, labor, outside, total, pending), unapprovedHours, unpricedHours, unpricedParts, projectList, currencies, sourceList (component, sourceType, sourceId, workEffortId, stepName, date, description, quantity, amount, currencyUomId, state, postingText, rateText for labor, costCenterId, projectWorkEffortId, with texts), sourcesCapped and, for one work order, estimate (known, amount, parts, labor, currencyUomId, unknownList: the Approve gate's cost half, never stored).

parameter.name: component
parameter.description: parts, labor or outside; every component when empty

service.description: The work status report (design §8 WorkStatusReport; impl-maintenance P17; MAINTENANCE_VIEW in the scope's organizations, PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise, ORGANIZATION_DENIED for another organization), over execution roots only (procedures and process steps are never counted), at most 2000 (summary.capped): in the period from fromDate (30 days before the as-of time unless given) to the as-of time (thruDate, now unless given), the work orders opened (created), completed (first completed in the period and still complete at the as-of time: a completion reopened is not counted, an order completed, reopened and completed again counts once) and cancelled, and at the as-of time the backlog (open), the overdue (backlog past its required completion, never unscheduled work) and the unassigned (backlog with no technician), each from the status audit of the root. Narrowed to an organization, a facility (with those inside it), equipment, a team (at the as-of time), a source or a kind; grouped by state, team, resource, source, kind or none (groupList, each with the six counts); statusList the counted work orders, of one measure and one group when given (paged; pageNoLimit to 2000). No cost, rate or amount.

parameter.name: thruDate
parameter.description: The as-of time: the end of the period

parameter.name: groupBy
parameter.description: state, team (the default), resource, source, kind or none

parameter.name: measure
parameter.description: opened, completed, cancelled, backlog, overdue or unassigned: the rows of one measure (the summary counts all)

parameter.name: groupKey
parameter.description: The rows of one group of groupList
